item.lightning_expansion.spell_book/ligh:
Spell Book of Lightning Wizards, using storm magic to strike fast and leap between enemies
- Strengths: Burst damage that chains across groups
- Weaknesses: Low defense, spells need line of sight
- Equipment: Lightly armored
spell.lightning_expansion.spark_bolt.des: Shoots a crackling spark, causing {damage} lightning spell damage.
spell.lightning_expansion.shock.name: Shock
spell.lightning_expansion.shock.descript: Instantly shocks the targeted enemy, causing {damage} lightning spell damage.
spell.lightning_expansion.chain_lightnin: Hurls a homing bolt that jumps to nearby enemies, causing {damage} lightning spell damage on each hit.
Channels a continuous arc of lightning, causing {damage} lightning spell damage every {interval} seconds.
spell.lightning_expansion.thunderstorm.d: Calls a storm around you, striking all nearby enemies for {damage} lightning spell damage every {interval} seconds.
Charges yourself with static: increased lightning spell power for {effect_duration} seconds and a burst of speed.
spell.lightning_expansion.shock_nova.des: Discharges a nova of lightning, causing {damage} lightning spell damage to all nearby enemies and briefly slowing them.
